summary: E2E test of Memories Photo Frames app. Backend: 25/27 pytest passed (92.6%). Frontend user account flow + admin panel both work end-to-end. Found ONE backend security bug: GET /api/admin/reviews missing require_admin (returns 200 without any token / with a user token). Found ONE minor frontend issue: Admin Orders tab table renders headers but no rows even though dashboard Recent Orders shows 5 orders with customer names + ₹ totals.

critical.issue: Missing require_admin dependency in server.py line 1129-1142. Endpoint returns 200 WITHOUT any auth and with a USER token. Violates the RBAC requirement in the review request. Fix: add `admin=Depends(require_admin)` to get_admin_reviews().

ui_bugs.issue: Order Management table renders headers (Order ID / Customer / Items / Total / Status / Actions) but no data rows, even though /api/admin/orders returns 200 and dashboard 'Recent Orders' shows 5 orders with names + ₹ totals correctly. Likely a render/filter mapping issue in the Orders tab table (state vs response shape). Refresh button does not populate rows.

issues: Empty state shown when no orders — does not expose data-testid='orders-list' or data-testid='orders-loading' (both were count=0 in test). Consider adding data-testid='orders-empty' on the empty state container for testability. Functionality works.

action_items: Add `admin=Depends(require_admin)` to GET /api/admin/reviews handler (server.py ~line 1130) to enforce admin auth.
Investigate AdminPanel Orders tab — table body not rendering rows from /api/admin/orders response. Dashboard's Recent Orders works, so likely a different data path / state variable.
(Nit) Add data-testid='orders-empty' to AccountButton orders empty state for clearer test signals.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: get_admin_reviews (server.py L1129) lacks require_admin Depends — any caller can list reviews including pending unmoderated ones. Both DELETE and PUT review endpoints are protected, but GET is not.
Email normalization in /auth/register lowercases input — correct. Confirmed login still works with the lowercased email.
enrich_orders correctly maps total=total_amount and customer.name from users collection.
Frontend user flow (AccountButton) handles register → 4 tabs (Profile/Photos/Wallet/Orders), wallet/orders tabs load, session persists across reload (green dot present), logout + relogin work.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_admin.py covers user auth, admin auth, admin RBAC (parametrized over /admin/stats|orders|reviews|users), and enrichment shape. The /admin/reviews RBAC tests (test_no_token_401[/admin/reviews] and test_user_token_403[/admin/reviews]) will pass once require_admin is added. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_admin.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. For frontend, the Admin Orders tab rendering bug needs investigation in /app/frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.js — dashboard Recent Orders work fine (enrichment confirmed via UI screenshot showing customer names + ₹899 amounts), so the bug is local to the Orders tab table component.
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/admin/reviews lacks require_admin Depends, exposing review listing without auth. Likely an oversight when adding RBAC across admin endpoints — DELETE/PUT review handlers correctly use Depends(require_admin) but GET was missed. Reproduction: curl https://photo-frames-dash.preview.emergentagent.com/api/admin/reviews → returns 200 with reviews array (no auth header). Mitigation: add admin=Depends(require_admin) param to get_admin_reviews().
